correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge5\) and every complex coefficient vector, the signed sums are the vertices of a planar zonogon with circumradius \(M\), perimeter \(4L\), and at most \(2n\) sides. The sharp disk-perimeter inequality for an \(m\)-gon gives \(4L\le4nM\sin(\pi/(2n))\); equality forces a regular \(2n\)-gon, yielding exactly the stated equal-modulus/equispaced-direction coefficients. Parallel and zero-generator boundary cases are explicitly handled.
